## Transcript scrolling and ProMotion animations
- **Smooth scroll bar and page-length during streaming:** Stabilizes the transcript's vertical scroll bar thumb size and document height across lazy row realizations and live streaming updates, eliminating scroll bar jitter and page-length jumps while reading or scrolling. - **120 Hz ProMotion across custom glass and lens morphs:** Drives custom `@Animatable` glass lenses, composer cards, attachment flights, command panels and task plan chips at 80–120 Hz on ProMotion displays using public SwiftUI and Core Animation frame-rate APIs.

## Per-thread workspace and shared worktrees
- **Thread-scoped browser, terminals and inspector:** Each thread now keeps its own browser tabs, terminal sessions and inspector tabs. Switching threads shows that thread's active panels and agent browser view while background tabs and shells keep running. - **Shared worktrees:** Multiple agents can now work in the same Git worktree at the same time. New, forked or handed-off threads can join an existing checkout or reuse the worktree for a branch that is already checked out.
## Agent tools and browser automation
- **Expanded orchestration, worktree and desktop tools:** Agents can now create, fork, hand off, title, archive and wait on threads; create, archive and restore worktrees; attach task artifacts; and open files, inspector pages, browser tabs, terminals and reviews directly in Controller. - **Persistent browser JS REPL (`cua_repl`):** Agents have a per-thread JavaScript REPL with persistent top-level state, Playwright-style locators, incremental accessibility tree diffs and isolated clipboard access. - **Third-party models in Claude Code:** Sessions running non-Anthropic or custom endpoints now bypass Claude Code's built-in safety classifiers so the underlying model handles requests directly.
## Transcript scrolling and responsiveness
- **No jump when work collapses:** Completing a reply and collapsing live work steps into the summary row now settles cleanly without throwing the finished message off the bottom of the window or shifting a detached reading position. - **Reliable follow and bottom-inset unpinning:** Follow glides stay pinned across every frame, and scrolling into the composer band unpins consistently and shows the Jump to Latest chip. - **Faster startup and sidebar switching:** Preloads on-device title model availability, Connect credentials and Live Activity state off the main thread, and trims redundant sidebar and markdown link work.

## Motion and streaming
- **120 Hz ProMotion animations:** Custom glass morphs, the reasoning-effort card and slider, the context meter, the activity orb and its typing-to-check mark, the plan chip, the command menu, the jump-to-latest chip, dictation cleanup smoke, attachment flights, and conversation header transitions now run at 120 Hz on ProMotion displays across iPhone, iPad and Mac. - **Smoother live streaming:** Replies stream with lower per-token work and no layout pop-in as headings, lists, links, emphasis and tables form. Character fades continue smoothly when a reply finishes.
## Custom models for Claude Code
- **Custom system prompts and templates:** Each custom Claude model can now use the default prompt bundle (Opus 5, Opus 5.5, Fable 5.1, Slim or Full), the simple system prompt, or your own editable system prompt. Load any built-in template into the editor as a starting point and save reusable prompt bundles across Mac, iPhone and iPad. - **System-reminder compatibility:** Custom model endpoints and proxies now receive mid-conversation reminders and tool updates inside standard user turns instead of system-role turns that third-party endpoints drop.
